analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive days of 'wait-and-see' stance maintained. RSI entering the 20s, MACD histogram continues to worsen. ADX at 39.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is overwhelmingly dominant over +DI (-DI 51.7 vs +DI 7.7), showing strong downward pressure. The 5-day low ($148.80) is lower than the 20-day low ($148.80), confirming a Lower Low pattern. Approaching the lower Bollinger Band ($165.68). Increased volume suggests potential panic selling during the decline.
